flags.text: "Add inline citation badges with hover and focus previews to assistant answers. ([#233](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/233))" - PR #233 initially added these badges, but PR #244 removed that implementation during the Markdown integration and deferred inline badges. PR #245 later reintroduced them over sanitized Markdown. Listing #233 as an added feature in the resulting changelog misrepresents what remained.

"You can count on those views sharing the same spacing and corner styles." - The design tokens provide common spacing and radius scales, but the facts do not say the queue, board, and detail views use identical spacing or corner styles.

"The v1.9.0 frontend changes are now combined in one release. You can count on the assistant displaying formatted answers with citations in the Sources list." - The integration PR combined M9 changes and, at that point, displayed citations only in the Sources list. A separate later PR reintroduced inline badges for v1.9.0. The wording presents the sources-list-only integration state as the release's citation behavior.
